knowledgeBase.name: Insaaf AI Pakistani Legal Knowledge Base
knowledgeBase.description: Centralized repository of Pakistani legal knowledge for the Insaaf AI system. This knowledge base covers key domains of Pakistani law and is designed for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and offline fallback.

coverageClaims.disclaimer: This knowledge base does NOT claim to be a complete or exhaustive compilation of Pakistani law. It is a curated selection of key provisions from public legal sources for educational and legal guidance purposes.

domains.name: Criminal Law (Pakistan Penal Code)
domains.notes: Covers offences against person, property, cheating, fraud, forgery, criminal breach of trust, intimidation

domains.name: Criminal Procedure
domains.primaryLaw: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898)
domains.notes: Covers FIR, arrest, bail, remand, investigation, trial procedure, appeal

domains.name: Civil Procedure
domains.primaryLaw: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (Act V of 1908)
domains.notes: Covers civil suit filing, pleadings, interim orders, evidence, decree, execution, appeal

domains.name: Cybercrime / Digital Rights
domains.notes: Covers unauthorized access, cyberstalking, harassment, dignity offences, electronic fraud, FIA complaints

domains.name: Family Law
domains.primaryLaw: Muslim Family Laws Ordinance, 1961 and Related Legislation
domains.notes: Covers marriage, divorce (talaq/khula), maintenance, dower, custody, guardianship

domains.name: Property and Tenancy Law
domains.primaryLaw: Transfer of Property Act, 1882; Registration Act, 1908; Provincial Rent Laws
domains.sourceAuthority: Ministry of Law and Justice / Provincial Governments
domains.notes: Covers property transfer, registration, tenancy, eviction, mutation, property disputes, inheritance

domains.name: Labour and Employment Law
domains.primaryLaw: Industrial Relations Act, 2012; Standing Orders Ordinance, 1968; Factories Act, 1934
domains.sourceAuthority: Ministry of Overseas Pakistanis & HRD / Provincial Labour Departments
domains.notes: Covers wages, termination, harassment, EOBI, social security, working hours, leave, Labour Court

domains.name: Consumer Protection
domains.primaryLaw: Punjab Consumer Protection Act, 2005; Sindh Consumer Protection Act, 2014
domains.notes: Covers consumer rights, defective goods, complaint procedure, Consumer Courts, PSQCA

domains.name: Student and Education Rights
domains.primaryLaw: Constitution Article 25-A; HEC Act, 2002; Harassment Act, 2010
domains.sourceAuthority: Higher Education Commission / Ministry of Federal Education
domains.notes: Covers right to education, HEC attestation, university discipline, anti-harassment, scholarships, exam rights

domains.name: Legal Aid and Public Resources
domains.primaryLaw: Legal Aid and Justice Authority Act, 2020
domains.sourceAuthority: Ministry of Human Rights / Pakistan Bar Council
domains.notes: Covers DLAC, free legal aid, helplines, NGOs, ombudsman, human rights cell

domains.name: Court Procedures and Practical Guides
domains.notes: Covers FIR procedure, bail steps, writ petition, civil/criminal trial stages, consumer/cyber/family procedures

domains.name: Case Law and Precedents
domains.notes: 9 landmark judgments covering fundamental rights, FIR, environmental rights, rule of law, elections

domains.name: Pakistan + Foreign Countries / Overseas Pakistanis (Cross-Border)
domains.primaryLaw: Pakistan Citizenship Act 1951; Passport Act 1974; Emigration Ordinance 1979; Consular practice; foreign official procedures
domains.sourceAuthority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Ministry of Overseas Pakistanis & HRD / Bureau of Emigration & Overseas Employment / DGIP / NADRA / HEC / official foreign government sources
domains.notes: Two-layer knowledge: Layer A = Pakistan law/policy/consular; Layer B = foreign official procedure relevant to a Pakistani user. Jurisdiction metadata is kept on every record and the layers are never mixed. Subdomains: travel, passport, visa, immigration basics, overseas employment, study abroad, scholarships, foreign universities, Pakistani missions, consular services, overseas Pakistani rights, attestation/legalisation/apostille, power of attorney abroad, birth/marriage/death registration abroad, dual nationality, returning to Pakistan, foreign marriage/divorce recognition, cross-border family/property/inheritance, remittance/tax routing, overseas complaints, detention/arrest abroad, lost passport, emergency consular assistance, human trafficking/migrant-worker protection, bilateral agreements, treaties, foreign policy, international organisations, cross-border remedies, extradition/mutual legal assistance. Coverage is source-driven and NOT a claim to know every country's law; time-sensitive items carry a verification date and CURRENT/CLOSED/HISTORICAL status and prefer the live official source.

sourceHierarchy.tier1: Official legislation, official Gazette, Supreme Court, High Courts, official government departments, official regulators
sourceHierarchy.tier2: Official Bar Councils, official court portals, official legal-aid organizations, official institutional resources (HEC, MOHR)
sourceHierarchy.tier3: Reputable academic and legal sources (not used in current corpus)

prohibitions: Do not include confidential police records
Do not include private victim data
Do not fabricate case numbers or statutory text
Do not use random blogs as legal authority
